resources.string: Serve a downloaded or imported LiteRT-LM chat model to OpenAI-compatible clients. Close other model chats before starting to avoid loading two models.
Local model API service is active. Tap to manage or stop.
Could not start service. Check context length, model, available memory, backend and port; lower context length or try CPU.
Download or import a .litertlm chat model first

Supports text, images and client-side tool calling when supported by the selected model. The service uses HTTP; use a trusted network or USB forwarding. API calls require the API key; the health check does not. Android or battery settings may stop background execution.
The token is retrieved automatically when a gated model is downloaded
Android 17 requires local network access. Allow it in app permissions, then start again.
LAN base URLs (use the Wi-Fi address on your computer):
No LAN IPv4 address found. Connect Wi-Fi and refresh.
Local-only mode: other devices cannot connect. Stop the service and enable LAN access to change this.
To test connectivity, open http://PHONE_WIFI_IP:%1$d/health on another device; expected: status ok.
Use at least 16 printable ASCII characters without spaces.
Private inference on your device, ready for OpenAI-compatible clients.
Use a LiteRT-LM chat model. Close other model chats before starting.
Connect from another device on the same trusted network. Android 17 requires local network permission.
These addresses become available after the service starts.
Use the Wi-Fi address, not a VPN interface. The health check needs no API key.

Default 32K (32768); range 1024–262144. Includes history, images, tools and output. Larger settings need more memory; reduce this value if the model cannot start. Stop the service to change it.
